title: Steady-State and Transient Heat Conduction Analysis Using a Polygonal Cell-Based Smoothed Finite Element Method
summary: This paper presents a polygonal cell-based smoothed finite element method (CS-FEM) for two-dimensional steady-state and transient heat-conduction analysis. In the proposed formulation, Wachspress shape functions are employed to construct the temperature approximation over general polygonal elements, and the smoothed temperature gradient is evaluated through boundary integration over cell-based smoothing domains.
